meta.title: Presumptions, Rules, Lessons, and Proofs
meta.baseline: Most people are good and like good starts

class.label: Citizens
class.presumption: Presumed to act in good faith and community interest
class.rule: Benefit of the doubt in civic participation
class.proof: Consistent participation in local governance and volunteerism

class.label: Business Persons
class.presumption: Presumed to operate ethically within market norms
class.rule: Fair dealing and transparent pricing expected
class.lesson: Reputation compounds; short-term cheating fails long-term

class.label: Colleges and Universities
class.presumption: Presumed to advance knowledge and serve students honestly
class.lesson: Institutional trust takes decades to build, moments to lose
class.proof: Graduate outcomes, accreditation standing, research output

class.label: Retailers
class.presumption: Presumed to sell safe goods at fair value
class.proof: Low complaint rates, repeat business, community presence

class.label: Residential Owners
class.presumption: Presumed to maintain property and respect neighbors
class.rule: Property kept within code; boundaries respected
class.proof: Property upkeep, code compliance, neighbor relations

class.label: Investors
class.presumption: Presumed to seek returns through legitimate means
class.proof: Regulatory compliance, portfolio longevity, public filings

class.label: Scientists
class.presumption: Presumed to pursue truth through rigorous method
class.lesson: Scientific integrity outlasts any single finding
class.proof: Peer review acceptance, reproducibility, citation record

class.label: Hotel Operators
class.presumption: Presumed to provide safe and clean accommodations as advertised
class.rule: Health and safety standards met; bookings honored
class.proof: Inspection records, guest reviews, repeat bookings

class.label: Church and Religious Organizations
class.presumption: Presumed to serve spiritual and community welfare selflessly
class.rule: Stewardship of donated funds; care for vulnerable members
class.proof: Community outreach, financial transparency, member welfare

class.label: High-IQ Individuals (157+)
class.presumption: Presumed to apply intelligence toward constructive ends
class.rule: Capability implies responsibility; influence used for benefit
class.proof: Contributions to society, mentorship, creative or scientific output

class.label: Teachers of 157+ IQ
class.presumption: Presumed to elevate students beyond standard expectations
class.rule: Teach to potential, not to minimum; inspire independent thought
class.lesson: Great teachers multiply intelligence across generations
class.proof: Student advancement, original curricula, long-term student outcomes

class.label: Food Service Workers
class.presumption: Presumed to handle food safely and serve with care
class.lesson: Feeding people is a trust; consistency builds loyalty
class.proof: Health inspection scores, customer satisfaction, tenure

class.label: Bankers
class.presumption: Presumed to steward deposits and extend credit responsibly
class.rule: Fiduciary duty upheld; terms disclosed clearly
class.lesson: Trust is the only currency that underlies all others
class.proof: Regulatory standing, customer retention, fair lending records
